title: Finally saw the water park
content: It was towards the end of my dream but I was driving past this HUGE water park that looked like non I've been to, but it was so familiar to me. I remember as my friends and I drove past I got super excited and said it was where my family would go when I was a kid trying to inspire them to want to go too haha. I woke up shortly after that, but it was so cool and fully outdoors (funny cause the one I would go to as a kid was completely indoors besides a pool) and hope I can actually go in next time.
